trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.missableNote: Cannot be missed: it unlocks automatically once the other 54 trophies are earned.
trophies.guide: Earn every other trophy in the game and this one unlocks on its own — there is no separate task behind it. Work through the five roadmap stages in order and the platinum is the last pop you hear. The long pole is A Long Road, the 100% completion gold, so follow the 100% checklist from the start instead of leaving it all for the end.
steps: Finish stages 1 to 4 of the roadmap
Clear the stage 5 money, robbery and cleanup jobs
Reach 100% completion for the A Long Road gold
The platinum pops automatically

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.missableNote: Cannot be missed: it is the opening mission of the story.
trophies.guide: Finish the opening mission, Gone Fishing — the first story mission of the game. It unlocks almost as soon as the story begins, so there is nothing to prepare and nothing to look up. If you follow the roadmap, this is the first trophy you will earn.
steps: Start the story
Play the opening mission Gone Fishing to the end

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.missableNote: Cannot be missed: finishing Chapter 1 is required to reach the rest of the game.
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 1 of the story by playing its missions in order. Nothing in the chapter is missable as long as you meditate at the first meditation spot at Jason's house before the chapter ends — see Positive Mental Attitude, the one trophy in the game with a missable point. Keep a manual save at the chapter's end, since the game has no mission replay.
steps: Meditate at Jason's house before the chapter ends
Play every Chapter 1 mission in order
Keep a manual save when the chapter closes

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.missableNote: Cannot be missed: finishing Chapter 2 is required to reach the rest of the game.
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 2 by continuing the story missions in order; the trophy pops when the chapter's final mission ends. It is hidden on PlayStation until earned, so expect a surprise pop rather than a checklist item. No side content is needed for it.
steps: Play the Chapter 2 missions in story order
Finish the chapter's final mission

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.missableNote: Cannot be missed: finishing Chapter 3 is required to reach the rest of the game.
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 3 by playing its missions in story order; the trophy unlocks at the chapter's final mission. Keep pushing the story forward and it comes to you. No side content is needed for it.
steps: Play the Chapter 3 missions in story order
Finish the chapter's final mission

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.missableNote: Cannot be missed: finishing Chapter 4 is required to reach the finale.
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 4 by finishing the chapter's missions in story order. You are one chapter from the finale at this point, so keep a manual save at the chapter's end. No side content is needed for the trophy itself.
steps: Play the Chapter 4 missions in story order
Finish the chapter's final mission
Keep a manual save at the chapter's end

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.missableNote: Cannot be missed: the final mission must be finished to complete the story.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission of the game to earn this gold. Finish the closing mission and the trophy pops with the credits. After the story ends, free-roam opens up, so everything left on the list can be cleaned up without replaying the story.
steps: Finish Chapter 4 and start the finale
Complete the final mission
Free-roam opens for the cleanup stages

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.missableNote: Cannot be missed: Breakfast Run is a story mission that must be played.
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Breakfast Run. It is a story mission that unlocks in the natural course of the campaign, so play the story and it comes to you. No special preparation is needed.
steps: Play the story until Breakfast Run unlocks
Finish the mission

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.missableNote: Cannot be missed: The Cartel Heist is a story mission that must be played.
trophies.guide: Complete the mission The Cartel Heist. It is a story heist mission, so follow the story until it appears, then finish it. Bring your best driving and shooting to the escape, and keep a manual save before you start it.
steps: Play the story until The Cartel Heist unlocks
Finish the heist and the escape

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.missableNote: Cannot be missed: Child's Play is a story mission that must be played.
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Child's Play. It is a story mission that arrives as the campaign progresses, so finish it when it unlocks. Nothing outside the mission is required.
steps: Play the story until Child's Play unlocks
Finish the mission

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.missableNote: Cannot be missed: Headliners is a story mission that must be played.
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Headliners. Finish this story mission when it unlocks in the campaign. It is hidden until earned, so it will pop as a surprise.
steps: Play the story until Headliners unlocks
Finish the mission

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.missableNote: Cannot be missed: VCIA Takedown is a story mission that must be played.
trophies.guide: Complete the mission VCIA Takedown. It is a story mission tied to the airport, so play through the story until it appears and finish it. Expect a wanted level on the way out of the airport.
steps: Play the story until VCIA Takedown unlocks
Finish the mission and the airport escape

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.missableNote: Cannot be missed: Operation Savage Glory is a story mission that must be played.
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Operation Savage Glory. Finish this story mission when the campaign reaches it. It is one of the later story beats, so it arrives near the end of the campaign.
steps: Play the story until Operation Savage Glory unlocks
Finish the mission

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.missableNote: Cannot be missed, but it is the longest grind in the game: work on its checklist from stage 1 onward.
trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion as the in-game checklist measures it. The heavy lifts are 200 of 277 base vehicles discovered, 100 of 255 animals spotted with binoculars, 50 of 66 weapons, 70 of 80 challenges, 300 of 397 stunts (the trophy needs 250, 100% needs 300), and 15 of 18 meditations (the trophy needs all 18). Strangers & Freaks strands are NOT needed for 100%. Track the checklist in the pause menu and clear the biggest categories first.
steps: Open the 100% checklist in the pause menu
Clear vehicles, animals and weapons as you play
Push stunts from 250 to 300 and challenges to 70
Meditate at 15 of the 18 spots

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.missableNote: Cannot be missed: stunts can be done any time in free-roam after the story.
trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts. Stunts are the jumps, near-misses, drifts and airtime the game counts as you drive hard around Leonida, so chain them in free-roam driving sessions. You need 250 for the trophy and 300 of 397 for 100%, so keep going past the pop if you want the platinum. Long highway runs with ramps and traffic to dodge are the best farming.
steps: Drive fast and chain jumps, drifts and near-misses
Use highway runs with ramps for repeatable stunts
Reach 250, then push to 300 for 100% completion

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.missableNote: Cannot be missed: activities stay open in free-roam after the story.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once. Sample one of everything the game offers as an activity — racing, the shooting range, drone racing, fishing, arcade games, bowling, meditation, hunting and stunt driving are the kinds to check off. You do not need to win or finish any of them, just try each type once, and the in-game activity list shows which types you have sampled.
steps: Open the activity list to see the 9 types
Try one of each type, even briefly
The trophy pops on the ninth type

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.missableNote: Cannot be missed: shooting ranges stay open in free-roam after the story.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Visit the shooting ranges around Leonida and gold every challenge — accuracy and speed both matter, so use the weapon each challenge is built for and restart a challenge the moment a run goes wrong instead of finishing a bad one. The count is 42 in total across the ranges. This is one of the longest grinds in the game, so start it early and do a few challenges between story missions.
steps: Find a shooting range and open its challenge list
Gold each challenge with the weapon it is built for
Restart bad runs immediately; work through all 42

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.missableNote: Cannot be missed: drone races stay open in free-roam after the story.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every one of the 14 locations. Drone races are scattered across 14 spots in Leonida, and you need a win at each of them. Learn each course's corners before pushing for the win, and remember a win only counts at a location you have not won at yet.
steps: Open the Top Fun race list to see the 14 locations
Practice each course, then race for the win
Win once at all 14 locations

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.missableNote: Cannot be missed: races stay open in free-roam after the story.
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Race wins count only once per race, so you need 20 distinct races won, not 20 wins in total. Work through the race list across Leonida in free-roam; street races, off-road and water races all count toward the 20.
steps: Open the race list across Leonida
Win 20 distinct races, one win per race
Mix street, off-road and water races

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.missableNote: Cannot be missed: Cal's fishing challenge can be retried in free-roam.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Find Cal and take his fishing challenge, then out-fish him — steady reeling and watching the line tension beats mashing the button. The trophy pops the moment you beat his score, and you can retry the challenge if you lose.
steps: Find Cal and accept his fishing challenge
Reel steadily and watch line tension
Beat Cal's score to pop the trophy

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.missableNote: Cannot be missed: arcades stay open in free-roam after the story.
trophies.guide: Complete an arcade game. Step into an arcade, pick any game, and play it through to the end. No high score is needed; finishing one game is enough.
steps: Enter an arcade
Pick any arcade game
Play it through to the end

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.missableNote: Cannot be missed: Andy's missions stay open in free-roam after the story.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy. Work through Andy's mission chain as it opens up and finish his last mission. Side-story contacts unlock as the story progresses, so check your phone for Andy's calls between chapters.
steps: Answer Andy's calls as his missions unlock
Play his mission chain in order
Finish his final mission

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.missableNote: Cannot be missed: Kenton's missions stay open in free-roam after the story.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton. Finish Kenton's mission chain to its last mission. Kenton's jobs open up as the story advances, so keep answering his calls and play the chain in order.
steps: Answer Kenton's calls as his missions unlock
Play his mission chain in order
Finish his final mission

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.missableNote: Cannot be missed: Billy's missions stay open in free-roam after the story.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy. Play through Billy's mission chain and finish its final mission. Billy's strand is one of the side stories to clear in stage 2 of the roadmap.
steps: Answer Billy's calls as his missions unlock
Play his mission chain in order
Finish his final mission

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.missableNote: Cannot be missed: stranger strands stay open in free-roam after the story.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida. Strangers appear as markers on the map in free-roam, and each strand is a short chain of missions for one stranger. Finish any 8 strands — there are more than 8 in the world, so skip one that frustrates you and pick up another. Note that these strands are NOT needed for 100% completion.
steps: Look for stranger markers on the map in free-roam
Play a stranger's mission chain to the end
Finish 8 strands in total

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.missableNote: Cannot be missed: Randy's missions stay open in free-roam after the story.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy. Finish Randy's mission chain with his last mission. Randy's jobs unlock alongside the other side-story contacts, so answer his calls as they come in.
steps: Answer Randy's calls as his missions unlock
Play his mission chain in order
Finish his final mission

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.missableNote: Cannot be missed: Tyrone's missions stay open in free-roam after the story.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone. Play Tyrone's mission chain through to its final mission. Like the other side contacts, his missions appear as the story moves forward.
steps: Answer Tyrone's calls as his missions unlock
Play his mission chain in order
Finish his final mission

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.missableNote: THE ONLY MISSABLE TROPHY: the first meditation spot is at Jason's house in Chapter 1 and becomes permanently unavailable after that chapter ends. Meditate there before finishing Chapter 1.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 spots across Leonida. Meditation spots are quiet places in the world; sit and meditate at each of the 18. The first spot is at Jason's house in Chapter 1 and becomes permanently unavailable after that chapter ends, so meditate there before finishing Chapter 1 — this is the only missable trophy in the game. The remaining spots can be visited any time in free-roam, and only 15 of 18 count toward 100% completion, but the trophy needs all 18.
steps: In Chapter 1, meditate at Jason's house before the chapter ends
Find the other 17 meditation spots across Leonida
Meditate at each one to reach 18 of 18

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.missableNote: Cannot be missed: Bret's hunt stays open in free-roam after the story.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret's hunt asks you to track down one specific unique animal — follow his clues, use binoculars to spot it, and take the shot cleanly. The animal is unique, so a sloppy approach that scares it off costs you the attempt; approach downwind and take your time.
steps: Take Bret's hunt and follow his clues
Spot the unique animal with binoculars
Take a clean shot without scaring it off

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.missableNote: Cannot be missed: cards stay findable in free-roam after the story.
trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. Cards are hidden around Leonida, and each set needs its full run of cards. Collect and trade your way to three finished sets — check the collection screen to see which cards each set is missing, and sweep shops, homes and landmarks for the stragglers.
steps: Pick up cards as you explore Leonida
Check the collection screen for missing cards
Finish any 3 sets in full

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.missableNote: Cannot be missed: WAiNK spots stay open in free-roam after the story.
trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations. WAiNK spots are photo-worthy places across the state — open the WAiNK feature at each and snap it. There are more than 100 spots, so sweep the map region by region and you will pass 100 well before you run out.
steps: Open WAiNK at a photo spot and snap it
Sweep the map region by region
Reach 100 locations

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.missableNote: Cannot be missed: challenges stay open in free-roam after the story.
trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges. Challenges are the game's scattered side objectives — time trials, stunt targets, photo tasks and more. Finish any 50; the game counts 70 of 80 toward 100%, so the trophy is the easier half of that grind. Pick the quick ones first and save the fiddly ones for the 100% push.
steps: Open the challenge list
Clear the quick challenges first
Finish 50 in total

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.missableNote: Cannot be missed: wanted levels can be built any time in free-roam with your partner.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star wanted level with your partner and escape the heat. Build a 4-star wanted level while your partner is with you, then break line of sight and stay hidden until it clears. Use the countryside and water to break the search, and do not let your partner get caught out in the open.
steps: Bring your partner along
Build a 4-star wanted level
Break line of sight and stay hidden until it clears

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.missableNote: Cannot be missed: shops can be robbed any time in free-roam with your partner.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your wanted level. With your partner beside you, rob one shop, then immediately hit a second and a third while the wanted level stays active. Plan a route with three close shops, keep a fast car ready, and do not let the heat drop between robberies.
steps: Bring your partner and pick three close shops
Rob the first shop
Hit the second and third before the wanted level drops

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.missableNote: Cannot be missed: vehicles stay discoverable in free-roam after the story.
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Drive or enter 100 different vehicles and the game logs each new one. Variety is the trick: try every class — cars, bikes, boats, planes and the oddities — and check the vehicle log to see what you are missing. 100% completion needs 200 of 277, so keep discovering after this pops.
steps: Drive a wide variety of vehicles
Try every class: cars, bikes, boats, planes
Check the vehicle log for what is missing

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.missableNote: Cannot be missed: Combat Focus can be used any time in combat.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Trigger Combat Focus with a group of enemies close together, then drop 5 before the effect ends. A crowded street fight or a mission ambush is the best setup; switch targets fast and keep moving.
steps: Find a group of 5 or more enemies
Trigger Combat Focus
Drop 5 enemies before it ends

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.missableNote: Cannot be missed: the airport can be revisited in free-roam.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA. At the airport, leave in a way the airport did not schedule — grab a plane and take off without following the normal route. Expect the law to notice; the trophy pops once you are airborne and away.
steps: Go to VCIA airport
Take a plane
Leave without following the scheduled route

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.missableNote: Cannot be missed: high wanted levels can be built any time in free-roam.
trophies.guide: Deal with the Rhinos — the tanks. When the military rolls Rhinos out at high wanted levels, take one on: heavy weapons, sticky traps or a stolen Rhino of your own are the practical answers. The description is deliberately vague; surviving a tank encounter is the point.
steps: Build a high wanted level until Rhinos roll out
Hit a Rhino with heavy weapons or traps
Survive the encounter

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.missableNote: Cannot be missed: jewelry stores can be retried in free-roam.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Case the store, enter quietly, and take the goods without tripping an alarm or being spotted. Move slowly, avoid the cameras' cones, and leave before anyone raises the alarm — a silent approach with a quiet getaway car is the way.
steps: Case the jewelry store first
Enter quietly and avoid cameras
Take the goods and leave undetected

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.missableNote: Cannot be missed: bank vaults stay open in free-roam after the story.
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape. Hit five different bank vaults and get away clean each time. Plan each job with an escape route and a fast car; the vaults are spread across Leonida, so this is a stage-5 cleanup job best done once the story is finished.
steps: Find a bank vault and plan an escape route
Rob the vault
Escape clean, then repeat at 4 more vaults

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.missableNote: Cannot be missed: armored trucks patrol the roads in free-roam.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Find an armored truck on the road, stop it, take the cash and escape the police response. Blocking the truck with your own vehicle works; be ready to run the moment the doors open.
steps: Spot an armored truck on the road
Block it and stop it
Take the cash and escape the police

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.missableNote: Cannot be missed: every area can be visited in free-roam after the story.
trophies.guide: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida. Visit every named area on the map — the game counts an area once you have set foot in it. Sweep the map systematically, region by region, and use the area list to find the ones you have missed. The far corners and islands are the easy ones to forget.
steps: Open the area list to see all 52
Sweep the map region by region
Visit the far corners and islands last

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.missableNote: Cannot be missed: gang operations stay open in free-roam after the story.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. Every gang in Leonida runs illegal operations; rob one operation from each of the 9 gangs. Mark gang territory on the map and work through the list — one per gang is enough.
steps: Mark the 9 gangs' territory on the map
Rob one illegal operation per gang
Check the list until all 9 are done

Look for a cocktail spot with a view

Bowl a game and follow through

steps: Keep playing the story
The trophy pops at the partnership high point

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.missableNote: Cannot be missed by playing normally, but do NOT push toward Irredeemable: it is permanent.
trophies.guide: Choices made, for better or worse. PlayStation tracks 500 actions that change your Criminal Profile — the choices you make across the game, for better or worse. Play naturally and the count climbs; do NOT deliberately push toward Irredeemable, which is permanent. The trophy pops when the count reaches 500.
steps: Play the story and make choices naturally
Watch the Criminal Profile count climb
The trophy pops at 500 actions

Save big vehicle purchases for stage 5
Spend $100,000 in total across shops

trophies.missableNote: Cannot be missed: garage properties stay buyable in free-roam after the story.

Save up during stage 5
Buy all 8 garages

trophies.missableNote: Cannot be missed: vehicles can be registered any time in free-roam.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Open the Scooter Bros app and register 10 different vehicles to it. Any vehicle you drive can be registered, so register the interesting ones as you discover them.

Open the Scooter Bros app
Register it; repeat for 10 vehicles
